Julie was a person, a girl very full of life, as were Veronica, Sylvia, Vicky, Connie, Tanya, and Deborah.
朱莉是一个人，是一个充满生命力的女孩，薇罗尼卡、西尔维娅、维基、康妮、塔尼亚和黛博拉也是如此。

Julie was a person, a girl very full of life, as were Veronica, Sylvia, Vicky, Connie, Tanya, and Deborah.

segments.body:
They were real girls just like you.
她们就像你们一样，是活生生的女孩。
segments.text:
They were real girls just like you.
她们就像你们一样，是活生生的女孩。

segments.body:
And they died, just as you could die.
而她们死了，就像你们也可能会死一样。
segments.text:
And they died, just as you could die.
而她们死了，就像你们也可能会死一样。

segments.body:
Not because they had hurt anyone or angered anyone, but because they were on the street at the wrong time.
不是因为她们伤害了谁或惹恼了谁，而只是因为她们在错误的时间走在了街上。

segments.body:
That is what I find heartless and distressing.
这正是我觉得冷酷无情且令人心碎的地方。
segments.text:

segments.body:
The fact that they were killed.
事实是她们被杀害了。
segments.text:

segments.body:
Not the fact that a humane reporter wrote about the discovery of my daughter's body as if she were a real person.
而不是因为某位有人情味的记者在报道我女儿尸体被发现时，把她当成了一个真正的人来写。

segments.body:
I know now that girls are dragged from the streets almost every night, or they are enticed into cars and later left hurt and frightened, raped maybe, maybe even dead.
我现在知道了，几乎每天晚上都有女孩在街上被强行拖走，或者被诱骗上车，随后饱受伤害与惊吓，或许被强暴，甚至可能丧命。

segments.body:
This is not something unfortunate that happened two years ago.
这不是两年前发生的什么不幸的意外。
segments.text:
This is not something unfortunate that happened two years ago.
这不是两年前发生的什么不幸的意外。

segments.body:
This is something that could happen tonight, tomorrow, to you.
这是今晚、明天随时可能降临在你身上的事。
segments.text:

segments.body:
Every time you go out alone at night, you are at risk.
每次你独自在夜间外出，你都身处危险之中。
segments.text:

segments.body:
Every time you get into a stranger's car, you put your life in his hands.
每次你坐上陌生人的车，你就是把自己的生命交到了他手里。
segments.text:

segments.body:
I don't want you to be hurt or frightened for one moment.
我不想让你们有一分一秒受到伤害或感到惊恐。

segments.body:
Every time I hear of a girl raped or injured, my daughter dies in my heart again.
每当我听说有女孩被强暴或伤害，我女儿就在我的心中再次死去。
